sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
Drytac manufactures adhesive-coated products including print media, protective films, laminating films, mounting adhesives, and bonding tapes for graphic display and printing applications.

Industry: Materials & Manufacturing · Size: $50M-$250M · Products: Print Media, Laminating Films, Mounting Adhesives, Bonding Tapes, SpotOn SynTac, Polar Grip

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: Drytac scores 77 of 100 (tier A) at 90% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (20/30), application fit (24/25), company size (8/15), event engagement (15/15) and pain-point alignment (10/15).

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on graffiti resistance, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar's low-surface-energy face makes graffiti and overspray wipe off cleanly. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.
